Strings.Settings.AudioPaletteHint: Built-in palettes adapt to light and dark themes; custom colors stay unchanged. Spectrum colors represent low, medium and high energy. Waveform supports transparency. Changes apply immediately and are saved in personal settings.
Strings.Settings.BuiltinScriptReadOnly: Built-in script is read-only. Save as a personal template to edit.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintScope: scope name target declares its own groups and segments.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintTarget: current: selected range; subtitle: whole subtitle; range(start, count): graphemes starting at 1.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintUnit: group, grapheme, chunk(count), word, line, paragraph, or split("delimiter").
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintDelay: Delay before this scope starts; seconds or milliseconds.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintStagger: Time between adjacent group starts; seconds or milliseconds.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintOrder: forward starts in text order; reverse starts in the opposite order.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintState: normal supports transforms; active and inactive support paint properties only.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintRepeat: Positive integer number of complete cycles in a fixed segment.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintPingPong: Play forward then backward; fixed duration applies to each leg.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintCycle: Full cycle duration in a flex segment, including both pingpong legs; hold the last value for any remainder.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintCompress: Scale fixed durations, delay, stagger, and cycle durations together for short clips.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintReject: Reject clips shorter than the script's required timing envelope.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintEndpoints: Each animated property begins at 0 and ends at 1.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintFlex: Share all remaining clip time using this weight.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintVector: Vector (x, y), base, offset(x, y), factor(x, y)
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintColor: Linear color: rgba(r, g, b, a) or base; RGB supports HDR and alpha ranges from 0 to 1.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintPath: Path progress from 0 to 1; absolute values only.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintBase: The property value before applying the script.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintOffset: Add to the captured base value.
Strings.Settings.ScriptHintInterpolation: Interpolation from this keyframe to the next.

Strings.Workbench.LinkedKaraokeTimingHint: When enabled, start edits move preceding text groups, end or duration edits move following groups, and body drags move both sides. Other groups keep their durations and existing gaps. When disabled, each group is edited independently.
Strings.Workbench.CreateSelectedTimingHint: Enter start and end for untimed selected text; other text keeps its timing.
Strings.Workbench.GenerateAllTimingHint: Regenerate timing across the visible cue duration using complete Unicode graphemes, replacing enabled and cached groups while preserving text appearance. Undo restores the original groups.
Strings.Workbench.RestoreCachedTimingHint: Re-enable the timing groups saved when highlighting was disabled.
Strings.Workbench.SplitKaraokeGroupHint: Divide only the selected group into complete graphemes with equal durations.
Strings.Workbench.FitKaraokeAxisHint: Fit the visible cue window and all timing groups without changing timing.
Strings.Workbench.KaraokeAxisGestureHint: Ctrl/Meta-click toggles groups; Shift-click selects a text-order range. Left/right handles edit start/end; the body moves the group. Ctrl/Meta+wheel zooms, wheel scrolls overlap lanes, Shift+wheel pans time, Alt bypasses snapping.
Strings.Workbench.EnableKaraokeHint: With no timing data, first enable divides the visible cue duration among complete graphemes. Existing whole groups stay intact; cached disabled timing is restored first.
Strings.Workbench.MergeSelectedKaraokeGroupsHint: Ctrl/Meta-click to toggle groups; Shift-click selects a text-order range. Merge text-contiguous, time-touching groups with the same mode while retaining character appearance.
Strings.Workbench.MergeKaraokeSelectionMultiple: Select at least two timing groups on the axis first.
Strings.Workbench.MergeKaraokeSelectionContiguou: Select text-contiguous groups without skipping groups or untimed text.
Strings.Workbench.MergeKaraokeSelectionTimeAdjac: Selected times must touch end to start; resolve gaps, overlap, or backward timing first.
Strings.Workbench.MergeKaraokeSelectionMode: Selected groups must use the same highlight mode; make their modes match first.
